"Update details": the reverse of the build page's linked content. Data comes from wf_content_build_ref + wf_build_kb via WindowsBuilds\Widget\ThreadUpdateCard - all first-party, no model output. Deliberately script-free so it stays AMP-safe. A build is only linked when renderable = 1: wf_build_kb carries release-health rows back to 2015 but the build page renders from the UUP cache, so a resolved build is not always a linkable one. Articles that name only CVEs get the vulnerabilities card on its own.
